description: Preliminary price range in EUR excl. VAT for cutting simple rectangular parts from sheet material, from public rates. Rectangles only; shaped parts need submit_rfq. Pass destination_country (ISO code, for example DK) for shipments outside Estonia: the 150 EUR minimum order then applies. The result is a range, not an offer; material is not included. Limit: 30 calls per hour per IP.

destination_country.description: Delivery country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example DK or DE. Outside Estonia the 150 EUR minimum order applies; omit or use EE for Estonia

sheet.description: Optional sheet size, default 1250 x 2500 mm, at most 2070 x 4000 mm
